changes.description: [V3] `/sandbox` and local `/autonomous` mode are now available to all users, off by default
[V3] MCP tools now load on demand for every user, keeping unused tool schemas out of requests
[V3] `KIRO_HOME` now also relocates MCP config, permissions, sessions, powers and agent state
[V3] A saved `sandbox.json` with `enabled: true` now applies to headless runs
`--no-interactive` chat on the V1 engine now exits non-zero with the error that ended the turn instead of a misleading tool-approval error
[V3] MCP sign-ins are saved under `KIRO_HOME` when set; existing ones are copied over once
[V3] Animated WebP images are now sent to the model as PNG
[V3] Cloud config and other Kiro service requests fail after 15 seconds instead of hanging
[V3] MCP tools on streamable-HTTP servers keep working after the server drops its session
A relative, root, or home-folder `KIRO_HOME` is ignored and `~/.kiro` is used instead
[V3] In cloud sessions, the code intelligence indicator and `/code` panel now reflect the cloud workspace
GitHub and Google sign-ins are no longer signed out when the auth service returns a temporary error during token refresh
[V3] Notices in the transcript when a model refuses or is unavailable and the turn moves to another model
[V3] Agent upgrades refresh permissions after V2 setting changes until you edit them
Kiro CLI may now offer to switch you to V3 when you start a chat
Screen readers now follow streaming replies in the full TUI via the Screen reader option in `/settings display`
[V3] Agent upgrades preserve V2 workspace read access and `fs_read` skill trust
Scrolling back in `tmux` no longer shows a screen of blank rows after long replies
Launching after output without a trailing newline no longer draws the UI at an offset
Knowledge search no longer silently drops a chunk from a small knowledge base
Garbled text and stray characters around icons in chat on some Linux terminals and remote desktops
